declaration: Predeclared F1 characterization of the unchanged upwind/Euler solver. No application-wide accuracy qualification or solver correction. Existing A9 gates/configurations remain unchanged.
notes: Characterization completion is distinct from accuracy qualification. No new product accuracy threshold is invented.
The outlet flux uses the last cell average as a face approximation. Compare it separately with the continuum last-cell average and point outlet.
First upward threshold crossings use sampled brackets, not unqualified interpolated timestamps. Repeated crossings and missing discharge are explicit.
Decimation selects original samples from one run and never changes its integration trajectory.
Scheduled inlet has no semidiscrete reference in this batch; its refinement remains coupled space/time.
Reference roundoff estimates and cross-checks are numerical evidence, not formal interval enclosures.
